• Formats enterprise HTML template with OTP code

• Existing User: Validates active, updates provider
Zero duplicate emails guaranteed by UNIQUE constraint
• Validates user consent & issues Authorization Code
• Real-time OTP inbox delivery within 1-2 seconds
